ud1.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre bodhirukkhamūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
ud1.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅkena nisinno hoti vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī .
ud1.3:1.4: atha kho bhagavā tassa sattāhassa accayena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paticcasamuppādaṃ anulomaṃ paṭilomaṃ sādhukaṃ manas' ākāsi
ud1.3:2.1: iti. imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imass' uppādā idaṃ uppajjati;
ud1.3:2.2: imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati, yadidaṃ:
ud1.3:4.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
